svg.text: SYSTEM DESIGN · BRANCHES langchain-only (laptop) + docker-mysql (office PC)
SS Manufacturing · Intelligence Platform - ask the company data in plain English
React website -> Django JSON API -> a LangGraph graph of steps. The AI (Groq) writes the SQL and the answers; our own code gives it the facts, does the safety and checks every answer.

THE APP - Django project portal/ + React frontend/
React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
charts/ - ECharts (answers, ML Dashboard), three.js (3D graph).
stream: step · token · done; errors as JSON (401 / 403 / 404)
LangGraph graph portal/lc/graph.py - one question, step by step
retry: a problem or a MySQL error goes back to the AI to fix the SQL (max 3 tries, then 'failed')
the answer check finds a wrong amount, percent or stock date -> the answer is rewritten once
LangChain parts portal/lc/ (used by the graph steps)
llm.py - the model chain: Groq gpt-oss-120b (GROQ_API_KEY) -> the same model on GROQ_API_KEY_2 -> the qwen backup; the admin's choice = only
calls.py - a per-minute limit -> the other key at once; a daily limit -> that key rests; then the backup
prompts.py + chains.py - the SQL, rewrite, route, answer, documents and general prompts (streamed)
docs.py · pdfs.py · embeddings.py · vectorstore.py - notes and PDFs into Qdrant (FastEmbed, local, 0 tokens)
graph.py - the steps above + live events; a follow-up gets this chat's earlier questions
Always our own code - LangChain has nothing for these
sql_guard.py (one SELECT, allowed tables, max 500 rows) · warehouse.py (read-only login, 30 s)
period_check.py ("this year" = the financial year) · the date, today, name, ranking and forecast checks
answer_verify.py (amounts, percents never x100, the stock report date) · answer_check.py
audit.py · home.py · knowledge_graph.py · insights.py (ML Dashboard) - fixed read-only SQL, 0 tokens
The AI writes every answer; this code only gives it facts and checks the result - no fixed answer texts.
